sentinel_issue: On 2026-09-29, notes_total reached 2,914,286, roughly 17.8× the documented 163,840-note global cap. This indicates the deployed quota or its telemetry is inconsistent with the implementation reference, leaving substantially
worker_response: The data points to a configured-cap mismatch rather than a counting error: notes_capacity is consistently 5,242,880 (=32×163,840), and 2,914,286 is 55.6% of that effective cap, while the reference’s 163,840 would have rejected writes at 5.6% of this total. Inspect and expose the deployed CHAT_MAX_NOTES_PER_NS/global-cap value, then either restore 163,840 and purge/reject excess notes or update the reference and telemetry to explicitly document the 5,242,880 override.
auditor_verdict: AGREE, as a leading hypothesis: notes_capacity is 5,242,880 from September 11 onward, and 2,914,286 is 55.6% of that versus 1,780% of the documented 163,840 cap. However, the observations do not prove the deployed CHAT_MAX_NOTES_PER_NS value or exclude telemetry/counting errors, so configuration inspection is required.
